featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very smooth and satisfactory experience with my claim process at HDFC ERGO Health Insurance. The entire journey—from hospitalization to claim settlement—was handled efficiently and transparently.
The cashless claim process was quick, and the coordination between the hospital and the insurance team was well managed. There were clear communications at every step, and the approval process did not cause unnecessary delays. Most importantly, there were minimal deductions, which reflects fair claim assessment.
I would also like to specially mention Niraj Shinde – Health Insurance Expert, who helped me select the right policy. His knowledge of health insurance is excellent, and he guided me properly based on my needs. During the claim process as well, he was very helpful, supportive, and always available for assistance.
This experience reinforced the importance of having a good health insurance policy. In medical emergencies, financial stress can be significant, but with the right insurer and expert guidance, the burden becomes much lighter.
I would strongly recommend everyone not to delay buying health insurance. A reliable policy not only provides financial protection but also ensures peace of mind during critical times.
Overall, I appreciate HDFC ERGO for their prompt service, transparency, and customer support.

“I’ll get it later.” It’s a thought we’ve all had.

But when it comes to financial protection, postponing important decisions can create gaps we don’t see today.
This National Insurance Awareness Day, don’t just mark the day, let awareness be your first policy of protection.

[Bajaj Life, Life Goals Done, National Insurance Awareness Day, Insurance Awareness]

Give your team a secure financial future! With a flexible retirement savings plan that grows with them and includes built-in life cover, you’re not just investing in their present — you’re securing their financial future.

A century of trust and progress, captured in one unforgettable image.

Bajaj Group set a Guinness World Records™ title for the largest abdominal plank number at Bajaj Plankathon 2026 in New Delhi on 7 June 2026, with 1,084 participants coming together to form the number ‘100’.

As Bajaj Group celebrates this milestone year, the achievement reflects the trust placed in us by our customers and partners over the decades. Beyond the record, Bajaj Plankathon 2026 was anchored in a larger social purpose - supporting the treatment of 100,000 children battling challenging medical conditions.

Here’s to 100 years of growth and resilience, together.

Your financial plan shouldn’t have to choose between protection and growth. Introducing Bajaj Life Smart Secure, a plan that combines market-linked growth potential with life coverage for added financial security. Designed to help you work towards your long-term life goals while staying protected through life’s uncertainties.

To know more, visit bajajlifeinsurance.com or reach out to your insurance consultant.

One verified identity can make multiple financial processes simpler. Central Know Your Customer (CKYC) enables KYC details to be securely linked to a single number, helping reduce repeat documentation and supporting faster, more consistent onboarding across financial services.

Once registered, the same details can be used wherever required. To complete CKYC, visit your life insurer, or any authorised financial institution and finish the verification formalities. A straightforward step that adds efficiency to long-term financial planning.

Being away from home doesn’t mean your plans are unprotected. 

With our services now available in Dubai, managing your policy, claims, and funds is simple and reliable.

Aapki Punji, Aapka Adhikar is a Ministry of Finance, Government of India initiative aimed at helping citizens identify and claim their unclaimed financial assets.

Supporting this effort, Bajaj Life urges policyholders to connect with us and claim what is rightfully theirs. For any queries related to unclaimed policy amounts, contact 020 6712 1212 or write to customercare@bajajlife.com.

featured_reviews.name: naveen nathrani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sharing a serious and unresolved issue involving both a shipping line and a marine insurer, highlighting significant gaps in accountability and claims handling.
Two containers were shipped together on the same voyage with Interasia Lines Ltd. One container was delivered in sound condition, while the other arrived totally damaged at destination. In accordance with standard procedures, a damage survey was conducted within 24 hours of receipt.
The shipment was insured with TATA AIG Insurance under ICC (A) – All Risks cover, including War Risk policy. A marine insurance claim was duly lodged (Claim No. 4300160663A) with all documents that were available and requested at the time. The last communication from TATA AIG was on 02/06/2025, and the claim remains unsettled.
Despite:
ICC (A) All Risks coverage,
Timely damage survey, and
Clear evidence of selective damage (one container intact, one totally damaged),
Interasia Lines Ltd. has declined responsibility for the cargo damage, and TATA AIG Insurance has failed to bring the claim to a fair and timely conclusion.
For exporters and businesses, marine insurance and reliable shipping are meant to provide protection—not prolonged uncertainty. This experience raises serious concerns about post-shipment accountability, claims efficiency, and customer commitment.
This is shared in the interest of awareness and accountability, with the expectation that both parties act responsibly and resolve genuine cargo damage claims.
#TATAAIG

name: Bajaj General Insurance Ltd.
description:
Bajaj General Insurance Limited (formerly known as Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited) is one of India’s leading, most trusted and dynamic private general insurance companies. It is a subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv Limited, India’s leading financial services group.
It offers a range of customer-focused solutions, spanning motor, health, and home insurance and specialised products such as pet insurance, wedding, event protection, cyber and rural insurance.
Established in 2001, the company has grown its footprint to nearly 1,500 towns and cities across India, ensuring easy access to its customers.
It holds an [ICRA]AAA rating from ICRA Limited, reflecting the highest level of confidence in its financial strength and stability.
